author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 12 volume 2 (chapters 6-10) follows the 2023 science textbook: integrals (basic formulas, trigonometric, rational, applications, definite integrals by parts, mean value, Riemann sums, areas, volumes about Oy), differential equations (notion, separable, applications, characteristic equation, oscillation), probability (independent events, Bayes), two-variable statistics (Mayer line, linear correlation) and conics (standard and shifted parabola, ellipse, hyperbola). Basic-course statistics and counting lessons are marked as review. Grades 7-12 now follow the textbooks.
